description: Alarm engine scenarios shared by electron/src/engine-vectors.test.ts and android/app/src/test/java/com/yassine/alarmcalendar/engine/SharedVectorsTest.kt. Time is a fake clock starting at `start`; the list is pushed at `start` and again for a step with `push`. Events A, B and C stand for the uuids under `events`. A step sets the clock to `at` (running every wake-up on the way, like timers or AlarmManager would), pushes a new list if it has `push`, performs `action` (done, snooze or close, for `event`), then checks `ringing` (alarms on screen, compared as a set) and `pending` (completions made here and not drained: event, occurrence instant, snoozes used). `snoozesLeft` is the number of snoozes still offered, `snoozeLabel` the exact button text (null when there is no button) and `noticeShown` whether 'No snoozes left, do it now' is shown. Prayer windows (honest prayers): an occurrence may carry `windowEnd`; its ring then offers `laterMinutes` (the Later buttons) and `cantNow` ('until_last_call' or 'give_up') instead of a snooze, which `snoozeLabel` null shows, and a ringing row may assert `laterMinutes` and `cantNow` (null when the view has no prayer choices; left out of the row, they are not checked). Further actions: `later` (with `minutes`) and `cantNow` (with `variant`, the button the person saw: the engine refuses a press whose variant is no longer the current one; absent means the variant the view shows at that moment); a `pending` row may assert `doneAt`, when Prayed was pressed. The last call is windowEnd minus 20 minutes, or half the window when shorter; Later offers 20, 40 and 60 minutes while they end at least 10 minutes before the window does; a prayer is dismissed with no completion when its window ends.

scenarios.name: rings at its time and Done ends it
scenarios.note: The basic life of one alarm.

scenarios.name: snooze limit: the button counts down, then only Done is left
scenarios.note: max 2 snoozes of 1 minute; a snooze past the limit changes nothing.

scenarios.name: max_snoozes 0 never offers a snooze and shows no notice
scenarios.note: Nothing was ever offered, so there is nothing to explain.

scenarios.name: closed without a choice rings again after refire_seconds, and keeps doing so
scenarios.note: refire_seconds 120.

scenarios.name: coming back inside the grace window rings, older does not (inclusive at the edge)
scenarios.note: The list is pushed at 09:00 with grace 30: 08:20 is 40 min late, 08:30 exactly 30, 08:50 is 10.

scenarios.name: of several missed occurrences of one event only the latest rings
scenarios.note: Two are inside the window; the earlier one is never rung.

scenarios.name: a new occurrence of an event that is still ringing is dropped
scenarios.note: 09:05 comes due while 09:01 is on screen; it is not rung after Done either.

scenarios.name: silenced and completed occurrences never ring
scenarios.note: A cheat day silences, a completion on another device completes.

scenarios.name: a Done survives a later push that no longer flags it
scenarios.note: The push at 09:03 lists the same occurrence with completed false; it must not ring again.

scenarios.name: deleting an event dismisses its alarm; an occurrence leaving the list does not end a snooze
scenarios.note: B is snoozed, then a push drops B's occurrences but keeps its info: it still wakes.

scenarios.name: pre-prayer text: previous one logged
scenarios.note: B is done before A rings, so A shows its plain label.

scenarios.name: pre-prayer text: previous one not logged
scenarios.note: B is still ringing when A rings, so A shows the alternative text, decided at ring time.

scenarios.name: a shifted occurrence is done if it was done at the time it had before the shift
scenarios.note: A is done at 09:00:30; a later list moves it to 09:10 with originalAt 09:00:30.

scenarios.name: grace 0: an occurrence delivered 1 second late still rings (delivery tolerance)
scenarios.note: The list is pushed at 09:00:00 with grace_minutes 0 and the occurrence at 08:59:59.

scenarios.name: grace 0: 61 seconds late is skipped
scenarios.note: Beyond the 60 second tolerance and with no grace window the occurrence is gone, and never rings later.

scenarios.name: a prayer with a window shows no Snooze even when snoozes are allowed
scenarios.note: The prayer offers Later and Cant now instead; the window is 180 minutes, so every Later option fits and the last call is 14:40. Prayed records when it was pressed.

scenarios.name: Later +20 rings again every time, with no limit (and is not a snooze)
scenarios.note: Six Laters in a row with maxSnoozes 3: nothing is counted. The options shrink as the window runs out: 59.5 minutes left offers +20 and +40.

scenarios.name: Later options shrink near the end of the window
scenarios.note: Each option must still end 10 minutes before the window does: 50 minutes left offers +20 and +40, 30 left only +20, 25 left nothing.

scenarios.name: Can't now is silent until the last call, then the next Can't now gives the prayer up
scenarios.note: Last call = window end minus 20 minutes (14:40). At the last call the button says it gives up: it ends the alarm, no completion, and nothing rings again.

scenarios.name: Can't now pressed after the last call ends the alarm at once
scenarios.note: Reached with Later: +60 at 12:00 and 13:00, +40 at 14:00, which rings at 14:40, the last call. Cant now there gives up.

scenarios.name: a short window rings its last call 15 minutes before the end
scenarios.note: A 30 minute window: the last call is half the window (12:15), and only +20 still fits (12:20 is 10 minutes before the end).

scenarios.name: an unanswered prayer is dismissed when its window ends
scenarios.note: Closing the window without a choice re-rings every refire_seconds (120). At the window end (12:30) the alarm is dismissed and nothing is recorded; it does not ring again.

scenarios.name: Prayed after Later records the press time as doneAt
scenarios.note: done_at is what tells on time, late and qada apart, so it must be the moment Prayed was pressed, not the prayer time.

scenarios.name: a prayer without windowEnd behaves exactly as before: snooze button, no Later
scenarios.note: An older app (no windowEnd in the list) with this engine: the snooze rules apply and there is no Later or Cant now.

scenarios.name: a prayer whose window already closed does not ring on wake, even inside the grace window
scenarios.note: The device wakes at 12:31, one minute after the window ended and well inside grace 60: nothing rings. Woken at 12:29 it does ring.

scenarios.name: a prayer woken one minute before its window ends still rings
scenarios.note: Same list, woken at 12:29 (grace 60): it rings, with no Later option left, and is dismissed at 12:30.

scenarios.name: a Can't now pressed on a stale button is refused, never a silent give-up
scenarios.note: The press carries the variant the person saw (`variant`). Pressed at 14:39:30 the last-call button (until_last_call) is stale, the engine now says give_up: refused, the prayer keeps ringing and the screen redraws with the give_up button. A give_up press while the view still says until_last_call is refused too. Pressing what is shown works.
